CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2559 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f. Bus nonce: 8ddeb923d0afccbb941906ea350d89f1. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f` or `Fix review: blocked 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 8ddeb923d0afccbb941906ea350d89f1`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2559 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2559-8ddeb923`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2559 (roster PR), round 6, at the FROZEN head 802b3850, which already has a merge verdict (review 7adab9fd). This review exists only to route three earlier unrouted non-blocking items, because tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2559 (read-only) shows them and the merge train's pre-flight parks the PR on them, and the body may not be edited without moving the head (R4). carry_audit accepts a `Carry:` marker in a LATER verdict comment that names the item id. Do the full fix-review as before (the head has not changed; re-verify the body figures, the finder harness and the merge-tree result quickly and honestly), then post a verdict whose first line is `Fix review: merge 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f` and which carries these markers, each on its own line, exactly: `Carry: dismissed: the body was re-taken whole at this head and no longer says 18 to 20 (item d4da81d2)` ONLY IF you verify the body no longer contains that wording (otherwise report it as a blocker); `Carry: dismissed: the stage stays done and only the commit pin moves, as the re-taken body states (item a406c960)` ONLY IF the body states that; and `Carry: R10-ROSTER-OPS (item 7f85b089)` for the stale R10-MERGE-PR-MANDATE resume.note ("has no pull request"), to be rewritten in the next roster burst (verify the group R10-ROSTER-OPS exists on origin/main's roster via jq and that the note is indeed stale; if the note is not stale dismiss it with the evidence instead). Run `python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2559` at the end if you can (it reads GitHub; if it cannot, say so) and put its summary line in verdict.md. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt). A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR.
